text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wenesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Gunmen killed four people in Al Azharia village, near Chlef, 150 km (95 miles) southwest of Algiers. The killing came shortly after the security forces reopened a road which had been closed by the gunmen.
- The European Union says "Algeria is not an example in the matter of democracy but the unfolding democratic process there deserves our support".

- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia, reappointed nearly two weeks ago by President Liamine Zeroual, has kept main ministries unchanged reappointing interior, foreign, finance, trade, health and social affairs ministers.

- Ouyahia to annouce his government line-up today. President Liamine Zeroual intervend personally to break the deadlock over the formation of the cabinet amid strong bargaining between three partner parties in the government.

- Bomb kills three passers-by in central M'Sila, south of Algiers. About 50 villagers have been reportedly massacred by "terrorists" last week. Seventeen other villagers were killed five days earlier in a nearby village.
